## Round 2–4: VS Code muscle-memory, split editor, shortcuts

Builds on **0.1.20** with probe-round fixes and the round-4 workflow batch.

### Keybindings & discoverability
- **Ctrl+B** = file sidebar; **Bold** = Ctrl+Shift+B
- **Fold / Unfold** Ctrl+Shift+[ / ] (Linux `{`/`}` + shift spellings); palette paints the chords
- **Toggle Terminal** Ctrl+`; palette shows the tip
- **Palette key hints** for Fold, Unfold, Terminal, word wrap, line comment, and other bound rows
- **Ctrl+Shift+V** toggles editor|preview ↔ editor-only
- **Quit** with dirty buffers: Save / Don't save / Cancel
- **Help → Keyboard Shortcuts** (and palette / Ctrl+K Ctrl+S): searchable Action → chord list
- Palette query **`search`** hits **Find in files**

### Split Editor (two documents)
- **Split Editor Right** (Ctrl+\\) and **Split Editor Down** — two open docs side-by-side or stacked
- Palette lists Split Editor; View → Split Editor submenu
- Drag a tab onto an existing split to place it in the secondary pane

### Welcome & Explorer
- No-folder cold start: **Open folder… / Open… / New file** CTA bar
- Cold **folder** open prefers README / first `.md` instead of a blank Untitled
- Explorer header **New File / New Folder** icons always visible (not hover-only)

### Terminal & zoom
- No dual `$ Run a command…` composer while a PTY session is alive
- Kill stays labeled with a usable hit target
- Zoom status **100%** on a clean settings file; foreign `settings.json` fragments no longer steal `font_size`

### Preview & chrome
- Optional **Preview soft line breaks** (GFM breaks) in Settings
- Title-bar path copy is an explicit icon + debounced toast (no spam on ordinary clicks)

### Also from 0.1.20
- Larger fold-column hit feel; status selection counts characters (not bytes)
